name: Amherst College
summary: Liberal arts college in Massachusetts: 1,907 students, 43 majors, an open curriculum, a 7:1 student-to-faculty ratio and 94% living on campus.

ib.text: No IB points minimum is published. IB courses count as evidence of ambition and preparation but earn no credit or advanced standing. SAT or ACT scores are optional.

apply.via: Common App or Apply Coalition with Scoir

notes: Amherst follows a need-blind policy for domestic and international applicants and meets 100% of calculated financial need for admitted international students who apply for aid.
For 2026-27, tuition is $75,330, with housing $10,980, meals $9,340 and fees $710 billed on top.
Departments may let you skip introductory courses where you have done rigorous IB work, but this is the department's decision, not credit.
